question: Could you assess the relationship between the poverty rates from the previous year's census data and the percentage of births without maternal morbidity for the years 2016 to 2018? Use only data for births where no maternal morbidity was reported and for each year, use the 5-year census data from the year before to compute the Pearson correlation coefficient
sql:
WITH natality AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) AS birth_year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS AS county_fips,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) AS no_morbidity_births,
    SUM(Births) AS total_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE Year IN (DATE('2016-01-01'), DATE('2017-01-01'), DATE('2018-01-01'))
    AND Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
  GROUP BY birth_year, county_fips
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2016 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    n.birth_year,
    CASE n.birth_year
      WHEN 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate
      WHEN 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate
      WHEN 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate
    END AS poverty_rate,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(n.no_morbidity_births, n.total_births) * 100 AS no_morbidity_pct
  FROM natality n
  LEFT JOIN census_2015 c2015 ON n.county_fips = c2015.geo_id AND n.birth_year = 2016
  LEFT JOIN census_2016 c2016 ON n.county_fips = c2016.geo_id AND n.birth_year = 2017
  LEFT JOIN census_2017 c2017 ON n.county_fips = c2017.geo_id AND n.birth_year = 2018
  WHERE n.total_births > 0
    AND (CASE n.birth_year
      WHEN 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
    END)
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    birth_year,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    SUM(poverty_rate) AS sum_x,
    SUM(no_morbidity_pct) AS sum_y,
    SUM(poverty_rate * no_morbidity_pct) AS sum_xy,
    SUM(POWER(poverty_rate, 2)) AS sum_x2,
    SUM(POWER(no_morbidity_pct, 2)) AS sum_y2
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY birth_year
)
SELECT 
  birth_year,
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y,
      SQRT((n * sum_x2 - POWER(sum_x, 2)) * (n * sum_y2 - POWER(sum_y, 2)))
    ),
    6
  ) AS pearson_correlation
FROM stats
ORDER BY birth_year
